name: Sky Labs Inc.
summary: Sky Labs Inc. manufactures CART BP pro, a ring-type medical device as a blood pressure monitoring solution for healthcare professionals and patients. The company provides health monitoring services to prevent chronic disease as an AI healthcare platform company. Additionally, it develops CART ON, a healthcare platform that collects, analyzes, diagnoses, and distributes data from outpatients with chronic diseases. The company's device CART BP pro helps with accurate diagnosis and individualized medication by offering 24-hour ambulatory blood pressure monitoring data and health evaluation metrics. Sky Labs Inc. was founded in 2015 and is based in Seongnam-si, South Korea.
